channel.title: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
channel.description:
Dan and Patrick's daily antidote to doomscrolling: two or three genuinely good developments in science and tech with sources, honest disagreement about what they mean, and one concrete action with real numbers on its impact — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.description: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast Most media profits from making people feel powerless. This club starts from the opposite conviction: individuals are not powerless. The goals are ten minutes a day of genuinely good news with honest numbers, one concrete action a week called The Lever, and proof it works through the Do Positive Dispatch. Listeners can learn more and take the pledge at nerranetwork dot com. The hope is to build a habit of acting instead of doomscrolling. ...
